_source: Rows recorded 2026-09-30 from ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db (opencode 1.18.30, `session` table: 112 of 11169 rows have parent_id). Mapped to the SDK `Session` shape (`parent_id` column -> `parentID`, @opencode-ai/sdk types.gen.d.ts `Session.parentID?: string`). Titles of `task` child sessions end in `(@<agent> subagent)`; top-level rows have a NULL parent. Child and parent run in ONE opencode process, so process env cannot tell them apart.
